title: Pass JSX as children to skip re-renders

slides.say: A wrapper with its own state re-renders its children. Unless the children come in as JSX.
Here Panel creates SlowList itself. Every toggle of Panel’s state re-renders SlowList.
Now the parent creates SlowList and passes it as children. When Panel updates its own state, React knows the children did not change, so they do not re-render.
Rule of thumb: when a component visually wraps others, let it accept JSX as children.
